purpose: Cost measurement only; no formal sample substitution.
scope: Proposed complete pilot, not current R2 spending authorization. Bounded qualified subsets may run only after separate exact protocol and available authorized resources.
qualification_prerequisite: Per-cell source identity and end-to-end/path acceptance or evidenced root-cause outcome; RSS cannot block PCS/NR engineering.
aggregation: Per-cell P50/P95/min/max, with n=3 exploratory only; explicit censoring/timeouts; report unknown rather than infer tails.
Separate attempted dispatch, exact result, discrete path accepted, native/aligned collision, censored timeout and infrastructure error.

scheduler.paired_seed_order: Frozen paired seeds; deterministic interleaved method/planner order.
scheduler.claim: Exclusive immutable job attempt; record restart after interruption as new attempt linked to old evidence, never double-count.
scheduler.engineering_concurrency: Independent builds/reviews may run in parallel; isolate actual scientific timings.
scheduler.parallelism_limit: Determine from measured memory/CPU isolation; logical16 does not imply16 fair workers.

formal_forecast: Sum observed censored per-cell solve+verification+IO costs over500; separate CPU from wall and feasible concurrency, uncertainty and timeout scenarios.
approval_gate: Submit measured pilot costs and resource plan before formal18000. Pilot resource extension beyond R2 also requires approval.
